question: What is the graph of the linear function whose function table is shown?  Make the line by using the mouse pointer to slide the two points in the graph up and down.
doneInstruction: When you think you have made the correct line, click the Done button.

helpTexts.text: Use the function table to make ordered pairs.
The inputs will be x-coordinates, and outputs will be y-coordinates.
Slide the points up or down to match the ordered pairs you make.
